content.value_statement: Incomplete creator briefs cause confusion, missed requirements, and repeated revisions. This skill creates structured briefs with clear deliverables, messaging, timelines, compliance, rights, and payment terms.
actual_capabilities: Collects campaign, product, platform, deliverable, timeline, message, CTA, and compensation requirements.
Generates creator briefs with overview, messaging, deliverables, creative direction, approval steps, compliance, rights, payment, and contacts.
Adapts guidance for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and common influencer campaign types.
Captures creator voice patterns and proof-backed topic authority for more authentic direction.
Marks unsupported claims as unresolved and prevents creator-ready status until they are addressed.
Saves a completed brief to an approved memory path when the user grants permission.
limitations: It does not select creators or allocate campaign budgets.
It cannot verify claims, platform specifications, or contact records without supplied data or optional connectors.
Legal, disclosure, payment, and usage-rights terms require review for the relevant jurisdiction and agreement.
Missing campaign inputs remain unresolved and can prevent a creator-ready result.

use_cases.title: Launch a Creator Campaign
use_cases.description: Turn product launch details into a consistent brief for several creators and platforms.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Briefs
use_cases.description: Create reusable brief structures with clear approvals, rights, disclosures, and payment terms.

use_cases.title: Protect Creator Voice
use_cases.description: Translate campaign requirements into practical guidance that preserves authentic language and creative freedom.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an influencer brief for [campaign] promoting [product] on [platform]. Include [deliverables], [timeline], and [compensation].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the main campaign details are already available.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [platform] product review brief for [creator type]. Use this key message: [message]. Add disclosure, CTA, and usage rights.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for one content format with a defined marketing message.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a multi-platform launch brief for [brand]. Include [deliverables], creator freedom, approval milestones, revision limits, payment terms, and campaign assets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for coordinated launches across several platforms or creators.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Approved Claims and Voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the supplied narrative canon, approved claims, creator voice intake, and campaign details to create a creator-ready brief. Mark unsupported claims as unresolved.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when compliance, evidence, and creator-specific direction must be traced.

output_examples.input: Create an Instagram Reel brief for a skincare launch with one video, a draft review, and six-month reposting rights.
output_examples.output: A structured Reel brief defines the campaign goal, approved benefits, one-video specifications, creative direction, disclosure placement, draft dates, review steps, payment, and six-month reposting rights.

output_examples.input: Prepare TikTok and YouTube Shorts briefs for micro-creators promoting an organic protein powder.
output_examples.output: The brief separates platform deliverables, hook guidance, approved ingredient claims, required disclosures, CTA, production dates, revision limits, compensation, and paid usage permissions.

output_examples.input: Create an ambassador brief that follows the supplied creator voice intake and flags unsupported claims.
output_examples.output: The result uses the creator's established language patterns, links messages to approved claims, marks missing evidence, and withholds creator-ready status until resolution.

best_practices: Provide approved claims, exact deliverable quantities, dates, compensation, usage rights, and disclosure requirements before drafting.
Share real creator examples or complete the voice intake when authentic tone is important.
Review legal terms, platform requirements, and unresolved placeholders before sending the brief.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the brief as a rigid script that removes creator judgment.
Do not include unsupported product claims or leave disclosure and usage rights unclear.
Do not request saving or connector access without confirming permission and data scope.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for TikTok, Instagram formats, YouTube videos, and YouTube Shorts.

faq.question: Can it create briefs for several creators?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide shared campaign requirements and creator-specific details for personalized sections.

faq.question: Does it verify marketing claims?
faq.answer: No. It uses supplied approved claims and marks unsupported wording for resolution.

faq.question: Can it determine the campaign budget?
faq.answer: No. It records compensation terms but does not allocate spending across creators or platforms.

faq.question: Does it save the completed brief?
faq.answer: It can save to the documented memory path after the user grants permission.

faq.question: Does the output replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. Disclosure, usage rights, payment, and contract terms require appropriate legal and business review.
